bill.title: A resolution designating the week of September 14 through September 18, 2026, as "National Clean Energy Week".

action.description: Under authority of the order of the Senate of September 30, 2026, ordered referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

posted_text:
⚡ US SRES 950 — Congress Aims to Highlight Clean Energy

The Senate is proposing to officially recognize the week of September 14-18, 2026, as ‘National Clean Energy Week’.

This resolution aims to boost awareness of clean energy’s growing role in the U.S.

economy and encourage investment in technologies like solar and wind power.

It also calls on the federal government and local communities to support clean energy jobs and solutions for a sustainable energy future.

Oct. 15, 2026: Under authority of the order of the Senate of September 30, 2026, ordered referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/senate-resolution/950
